subject: Renewal + Reserved Pool Increase — PO amendment & billing schedule
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@aeromedops.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@aeromedops.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Request: co-term expansion + PO amendment for Dedicated GPUs

Hi Rishi,

Quick one — as we approach our April 1 renewal, we want to increase our dedicated pool to support an additional 8 A100s (equivalent capacity) to cover an upcoming product launch. We'd like to co-term the added capacity with the renewal (so everything expires on Apr 1, 2027) and roll the amendment into a single PO rather than signing a separate commitment mid-term.

Key asks:
- Proposal for the one-time proration (Mar 3 — Apr 1) and the recurring billing starting Apr 1.
- Confirmation of throughput / sustained concurrency guarantees (we're planning ~150 r/s at 512 token avg, peaks ~350 r/s for 8–12 hours) and whether SLA addendum is required.
- Updated PO that amends the renewal to include the 8 GPUs and the updated billing schedule.

I've attached our existing contract for reference. Let me know if you need expected traffic patterns in a different format — happy to share our telemetry.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Infrastructure
AeroMedOps

Attachment: current_contract_signed.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@aeromedops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: co-term expansion + PO amendment for Dedicated GPUs

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear summary. We can absolutely do a co-term amendment + PO consolidation. Next steps from our side:

1) I'll confirm proration math and produce an amended PO for signature.
2) Marissa and Finance will propose the billing schedule and an itemized cost (monthly + any one-time pro-rated charge).
3) Grace / Applied ML Ops will validate the throughput estimate and confirm whether the SLA addendum is required for the throughput you listed. If an SLA is needed we'll include an explicit throughput guarantee and a remedies section.

A couple of quick clarifying Qs that will help pricing:
- Can you confirm whether the additional capacity will be used with 1) our standard inference offering or 2) with any custom model optimizations (quantized / pruned) — that changes GPU utilization assumptions.
- Do you want the new pool to be dedicated-only (isolated) or a burst-to-shared option for overnight/low-cost runs?

I'll loop back by EOD Wednesday with a draft PO and cost breakdown.

Best,
Rishi
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request: co-term expansion + PO amendment for Dedicated GPUs

Rishi / team — put together a draft cost + billing approach based on Liam's traffic and the assumption that AeroMedOps will deploy standard FP32 models (no extra quantization). See attached capacity_plan_v3.pdf for the breakdown. Highlights: 

- Increment: +8 A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved pool).
- Proration (Mar 3 — Apr 1): we calculate a one-time charge = $29,400 (30 days of added capacity pro-rated).
- Recurring (starting Apr 1): $8,800/month for the 8-GPU reserved pool (this reflects a 12-month committed price with co-term).
- SLA addendum for throughput guarantees (we can commit to sustained 150 r/s @512 tokens per second as a funded add-on) — additional $2,500/month and an incident credit policy in case of breach.

Procurement notes: we'll produce an amended PO that:
- co-terms to Apr 1, 2027;
- lists the proration as a one-time line item;
- includes an optional SLA addendum as an attachment to be signed if they opt-in.

I've attached: capacity_plan_v3.pdf and a PO amendment skeleton (amended_po_draft.docx). If legal needs to iterate, fine — but these numbers are ready to be sent to the customer.

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations

Attachments: capacity_plan_v3.pdf, amended_po_draft.docx

Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed PO amendment & billing schedule for reserved pool increase (AeroMedOps)

Hi Liam — thanks for the call last week. Per our internal analysis, please find summary and next steps below. We're ready to update the contract and issue a consolidated PO for signature.

Summary of proposal:
- Add: 8 A100-equivalent GPUs as a dedicated reserved pool.
- Prorated one-time charge (Mar 3 — Apr 1): $29,400.
- Recurring (billed monthly beginning Apr 1, 2026): $8,800/month.
- Optional SLA addendum for sustained throughput guarantees (150 r/s @512 tokens): +$2,500/month.
- Co-term: All additions will expire on Apr 1, 2027 to match your renewal.

Documents attached: amended_po_draft.docx (PO + line-item proration + optional SLA addendum).
Action items / timeline:
1) Please review the attached PO and confirm acceptance or redlines.
2) If approved, we will send via DocuSign (link below) for e-signature.
3) Once signed, Finance will issue the proration invoice for immediate settlement and the recurring charge will commence Apr 1.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder-envelope/ABC-123-DEF

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call to walk through the PO.

Best,
